description: This file contains CSS styles and variables for managing themes in a React application, specifically for light and dark themes, as well as defining styles for various components such as buttons, headers, and the application layout.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The primary container for the application UI, styled to center its content and adjust background color based on the selected theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: A class for the application logo with styles including size and animation.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header section of the application, including layout and color properties.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for the application links with a focus on color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles between light and dark themes, including hover and active states.
